description: This file defines a React component 'ExecutionScatterPlot' that visualizes workflow execution data using a scatter plot. It processes an array of workflow nodes, formats data for display, manages zooming interactions, and renders a chart with tooltips and reference lines. The component is intended for inclusion in a web application's frontend UI to represent execution timelines and durations.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string (ms, s, m).

methods.name: ExecutionScatterPlot
methods.description: React component that renders a scatter plot of workflow execution nodes with zoom and tooltip functionalities.
